edges.description: The chondrocyte arm is the weaker of the two. Functional data in chondrocytes implicate CFAP410 in cartilage differentiation, but the intervening ciliary signalling step has not been assayed in this disease.

nodes.description: The radiographic signature, and the reason the disease is recognizable: mild platyspondyly, cupped and flared anterior rib ends, irregular proximal femoral metaphyses, and lacy iliac wings. Unlike the retinal lesion this is largely static once growth is complete.

evidence.reference_title: Axial Spondylometaphyseal Dysplasia Is Caused by C21orf2 Mutations.
evidence.snippet: C21orf2 mutations presented with a wide range of skeletal phenotypes, including cupped and flared anterior ends of ribs, lacy ilia and metaphyseal dysplasia of proximal femora.

nodes.description: Two loci, one complex. Five biallelic CFAP410 variants across six of nine originally studied families, and compound heterozygous NEK1 variants in a subsequent patient. The most severe skeletal and ophthalmic phenotypes track with variants in the conserved leucine-rich regions of CFAP410, which is the part that contacts NEK1.

evidence.reference_title: Axial Spondylometaphyseal Dysplasia Is Caused by C21orf2 Mutations.
evidence.snippet: We found a total of five biallelic C21orf2 mutations in six families out of nine: three missense and two splicing mutations in patients with various ethnic backgrounds.

evidence.reference_title: Axial spondylometaphyseal dysplasia is also caused by NEK1 mutations.
evidence.snippet: By whole-exome sequencing in a patient with axial SMD, we identified compound heterozygous mutations of NEK1, c.3107C>G (p.S1036*) and c.3830A>C (p.D1277A), which co-segregated in the family.

evidence.reference_title: Variants in CFAP410 cause a range of retinal and skeletal phenotypes.
evidence.snippet: Patients with the most severe ophthalmic and skeletal phenotypes had disease-associated variants within conserved leucine-rich regions of CFAP410

nodes.description: Loss of the complex compromises assembly and maintenance of the primary cilium. CFAP410 sits with the basal body and ciliopathy-associated protein modules, and an unbiased whole-genome ciliogenesis screen placed it there independently of any disease hypothesis.

evidence.reference_title: An siRNA-based functional genomics screen for the identification of regulators of ciliogenesis and ciliopathy genes.
evidence.snippet: Biochemical approaches place C21orf2 within key ciliopathy-associated protein modules, offering an explanation for the skeletal and retinal involvement observed in individuals with C21orf2 variants.

evidence.reference_title: Axial Spondylometaphyseal Dysplasia Is Caused by C21orf2 Mutations.
evidence.snippet: Our study indicates that axial SMD is a member of a unique group of ciliopathy affecting skeleton and retina.

nodes.description: Endogenous NEK1 and CFAP410 form a tight complex in human cells. CFAP410 is a 256-residue leucine-rich protein whose repeat region binds the NEK1 C-terminal interaction domain; NEK1 is a NIMA-related kinase. The complex is the functional unit, and it has two jobs that this disease separates: building the cilium, and repairing double-strand breaks.

evidence.reference_title: Functional characterization of C21ORF2 association with the NEK1 kinase mutated in human in diseases.
evidence.snippet: Here, we report that endogenous NEK1 and C21ORF2 form a tight complex in human cells.

evidence.reference_title: Variants in CFAP410 cause a range of retinal and skeletal phenotypes.
evidence.snippet: The protein encoded by CFAP410 is 256 residues long, rich in leucine residues, and involved in ciliogenesis and the maintenance of cilia in photoreceptor cells of the retina

molecular_functions: CFAP410 binding to the NEK1 C-terminal interaction domain

nodes.description: Disturbed chondrocyte differentiation in the growth plates that build the vertebrae, ribs, ilia and proximal femora. Why those sites and not the whole skeleton is unexplained; the distribution is what makes the dysplasia "axial".

evidence.reference_title: Axial Spondylometaphyseal Dysplasia Is Caused by C21orf2 Mutations.
evidence.snippet: Functional data in chondrocyte suggest C21orf2 is implicated in cartilage differentiation.

nodes.description: The second job of the complex. CFAP410 is required for homologous recombination, and CFAP410 depletion reduces repair efficiency. Whether this arm contributes to the skeletal or retinal lesion in axial SMD, or is simply another consequence of the same complex being broken, is not established - see the knowledge gap below.

biological_processes: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

evidence.reference_title: Functional characterization of C21ORF2 association with the NEK1 kinase mutated in human in diseases.
evidence.snippet: The NEK1 kinase controls ciliogenesis, mitosis, and DNA repair, and NEK1 mutations cause human diseases including axial spondylometaphyseal dysplasia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

nodes.description: The retinal dystrophy is progressive and has no disease-modifying therapy. Management is surveillance and visual rehabilitation.

nodes.description: The thorax is too small before it is anything else. Mild to moderate respiratory problems in the neonatal period are part of the defined clinical picture, not an incidental complication. No `severity` value is recorded: the source reports a range, the slot is single-valued, and picking either end would assert a grade the source does not.

evidence.reference_title: Axial spondylometaphyseal dysplasia: additional reports.
evidence.snippet: The main clinical findings are postnatal growth failure, rhizomelic short stature in early childhood evolving into short trunk in late childhood, and thoracic hypoplasia that may cause mild to moderate respiratory problems in the neonatal period and later susceptibility to airway infection.

nodes.description: The photoreceptor outer segment is a modified cilium and everything it needs passes through the connecting cilium. CFAP410 localizes there, in cones and rods, and pathogenic variants reduce protein stability and mislocalize it.

evidence.reference_title: Axial Spondylometaphyseal Dysplasia Is Caused by C21orf2 Mutations.
evidence.snippet: C21orf2 protein was localized to the connecting cilium of the cone and rod photoreceptors, confirming its significance in retinal function.

evidence.reference_title: Expanding the genotypic and phenotypic spectra with a novel variant in the ciliopathy gene, CFAP410, associated with selective cone degeneration.
evidence.snippet: Pathogenic CFAP410 variants reduce protein stability, impair cytoplasmic localisation and result in dysfunction of rod and cone photoreceptors

evidence.reference_title: Axial spondylometaphyseal dysplasia.
evidence.snippet: We present a previously undescribed skeletal dysplasia characterized by mild platyspondyly, small thorax with cupping of the anterior ends of the ribs, irregular proximal femoral metaphyses, and lacy appearance of the iliac wings.

nodes.description:
The retinal phenotype is progressive, unlike the skeletal one, and visual function deteriorates rapidly once it comes to attention.
Read the cone-rod and rod-cone labels carefully here, because they are not two populations. In the clinically defined axial SMD series the SAME patients are called retinitis pigmentosa or pigmentary retinal degeneration on fundoscopy and cone-rod dystrophy on electroretinogram - the two names are two instruments looking at one retina. The roughly two-to-one cone-rod majority reported in the large CFAP410 ophthalmic cohort is a different observation, in a population ascertained through eye clinics rather than through the skeletal phenotype.

evidence.snippet: Axial spondylometaphyseal dysplasia (axial SMD) is an autosomal recessive disease characterized by dysplasia of axial skeleton and retinal dystrophy.

nodes.description: The small thorax with cupped anterior rib ends limits chest wall excursion. This is the mechanism by which a skeletal dysplasia becomes a respiratory illness, and it is the same constraint that the ciliopathy module's skeletal node describes - minus the polydactyly that node also carries.
